hp.name: High Plains Mallard Management Unit
hp.bounds: West of a line from the International Toll Bridge at Del Rio, north along US 277 to Abilene, SH 351 and SH 6 to Albany, US 283 to Vernon, east along US 183 to Oklahoma. Western goose zone.
hp.note: Ducks Oct 24–25 and Oct 30 – Jan 31. Geese (Western zone) Nov 7 – Feb 7.

nw.name: North Zone — Western goose zone
nw.bounds: North duck zone, west of the goose line (I-35 and 35W from Laredo to Fort Worth, US 81 / 287 to Bowie, US 81 to Oklahoma).
nw.note: Ducks Nov 14–29 and Dec 5 – Jan 31. Geese Nov 7 – Feb 7.

ne.name: North Zone — Eastern goose zone
ne.bounds: North duck zone, east of the goose line.
ne.note: Ducks Nov 14–29 and Dec 5 – Jan 31. Dark geese Nov 7 – Jan 31, light geese to Feb 19; early Canada geese Sept 12–27.

sw.name: South Zone — Western goose zone
sw.bounds: South of US 90 (Del Rio to San Antonio) and I-10 (San Antonio to Louisiana), west of I-35.
sw.note: Ducks Nov 7–29 and Dec 12 – Jan 31. Geese Nov 7 – Feb 7.

se.name: South Zone — Eastern goose zone
se.bounds: South duck zone, east of I-35 (includes the coast).
se.note: Ducks Nov 7–29 and Dec 12 – Jan 31. Dark geese Nov 7 – Jan 31, light geese to Feb 19; early Canada geese Sept 12–27.

seasonsNote: Duck zones: High Plains Mallard Management Unit, North and South. Goose zones: Western and Eastern. Dusky ducks (mottled, Mexican, black and hybrids) are closed the first five days of each zone’s season.

seasons.label: “Dusky” ducks (mottled, Mexican, black)
seasons.note: Closed the first five days of each zone’s season; legal on youth and veterans days.

seasons.label: Youth-only days
seasons.note: 16 and under with an adult 18+. Geese legal on youth days.

bags.detail: Six ducks including mergansers, inside which the limits below apply.
Eastern zone: no more than 2 white-fronted geese.
As printed on TPWD’s goose page for both zones.
King and clapper rails 15; sora and Virginia rails 25; gallinules and moorhens 15.

duckSublimits.note: mottled, Mexican, black and hybrids; closed the first five days

rules.d: One-half hour before sunrise to sunset.
Federal rules: nontoxic shot for waterfowl and coots; shotguns limited to 3 shells.
TPWD wildlife management areas and public hunting lands need the Annual Public Hunting Permit and have their own dates and rules.
Same dates for both: HPMMU Oct 17–18, North Nov 7–8, South Oct 31 – Nov 1.

licences.d: Waterfowl, coot, rail, gallinule, snipe, dove, crane, woodcock.

geometryNote: Geometry: duck and goose zone lines routed on the roads in TPWD’s zone wording (OpenStreetMap), split against the Census TIGER outline and welded to Louisiana, Arkansas and Oklahoma; TPWD wildlife management areas and public hunting lands; TPWD public boat ramps; USGS NHD and GNIS; USFWS (refuge units; NWI marsh); NOAA tides.
